GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA
NIZAMABAD DISTRICT
APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT UNDER PUBLIC HEALTH PROGRAMME UNDER
NATIONAL AYUSH MISSION (NAM), DEPARTMENT OF AYUSH, T.G., SECUNDERABAD
Outsourcing Basis – Nizamabad District
Applications are invited for the post notified for Nizamabad District. Candidates should use the form corresponding to the post
for which they are eligible and submit the required certificates/documents as prescribed in the notification.
Name of the Post
No. of
persons
engaging in
Nizamabad
District
Remuneration
AYUSH Doctor with PG
Qualification 1 ₹60,000 per month
AYUSH Medical Officer 2 ₹40,000 per month
Dietician 1 ₹20,000 per month
Psychosocial Counselor 1 ₹500 per session, at least 200 visits in a year (on call)
Yoga Professional 1 ₹28,000 per month
Age / reservation / selection: The supplied guidelines prescribe minimum age 18 years and maximum age 44 years, reckoned as
on 01/07/2026, with the stated relaxations; reservation is as per the applicable Telangana rules and Presidential Order. Selection is
based on the criteria specified in the notification.
Submission:
1. The applications will be received for the above said posts from Dt: _27-10-2026________ to Dt:__03-11-
2026_________________ between 10:30 AM to 05:00 PM (on working days).
2. Applications are to be submitted in person or through Registered Post at Room No 201.District Medical and Health Office
O/o. District Collector and Magistrate, Nizamabad District. 503001.
3. The applications which are received after the due date (i.e., Dt: 03-11-2026_), will be summarily rejected. District Selection
Committee is not responsible for the postal delays.
4. All the required certificates should be attested by Gazetted Officer.
